skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Midnight Delivery
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Midnight Delivery. As part of our cooperation agreement, Rhodes Island ordered this operator uniform for Exusiai. She can be seen wearing it, from time to time, during operations in Lungmen.
skins.quote: The night before the Doctor's team arrives at Lungmen, Exusiai and Texas have gathered all the intel needed. Before going back to rest, however, Texas forced her to put on this partner-provided uniform and rehearsed multiple courses of action.

skins.name: Wild Operation
skins.content:
Vitafield
[Rewilder] Series Classics/Wild Operation. Wind-resistant, dust-resistant, crackproof, and warm.
skins.usage: One of Exusiai's special work clothes.

skins.name: City Rider
skins.content: Rhodes Kitchen Collection/City Rider. Designed by Exusiai herself, 'I didn't think too much about the design, actually. I just made something that I'd like to wear.'
skins.quote: She might have forgotten that she's making a delivery.
